Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. The team sits between query planning and table scans, building the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution. As a Software Engineer, you’ll work with experienced engineers to build, test, and support well-scoped improvements to the execution engine.
